parameters.text:
❓ Comando no reconocido.

Usa uno de los siguientes:
• `APPROVE <draft_id>`
• `EDIT <draft_id>: <tu feedback>`
• `REJECT <draft_id>: <razón>`

parameters.query:
=UPDATE public.ai_email_drafts
SET status = 'approved',
    approved_by = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.from_user }}',
    approved_at = NOW(),
    updated_at  = NOW()
WHERE draft_id = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.draft_id }}'
RETURNING id, draft_id, from_email, customer_name, original_subject, status

values.content: Eres el asistente interno de VIP Tech Consulting. Tu tarea es reescribir un draft de email incorporando el feedback específico de un revisor humano. Mantén el tono profesional y cercano. Responde con un JSON que contenga: { "revised_subject": "...", "revised_body": "...", "changes_made": "Descripción breve de los cambios realizados" }

Eres un sistema de aprendizaje continuo. Tu tarea es extraer una lección concreta y reusable de una corrección humana a un draft de email. Responde con JSON: { "lesson": "La lección reusable en 1-2 oraciones", "situation_type": "tipo de situación (scope_creep, pricing, delivery, complaint, general, etc.)" }

parameters.query:
=-- Update draft record
UPDATE public.ai_email_drafts
SET status         = 'edited',
    human_feedback  = '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.human_feedback.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    draft_id        = '{{ $('Create Revised Gmail Draft').item.json.id || $('Create Revised Gmail Draft').item.json.message?.id }}',
    updated_at      = NOW()
WHERE draft_id = '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.draft_id }}';

-- Insert lesson
INSERT INTO public.ai_email_feedback_lessons (
  draft_id, quickbooks_customer_id, from_email, domain,
  situation_type, original_ai_reply, human_feedback, revised_reply, lesson
)
SELECT
  '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.draft_id }}',
  qb.quickbooks_customer_id,
  '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.from_email }}',
  split_part('{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.from_email }}', '@', 2),
  '{{ ($input.item.json.message?.content ? JSON.parse($input.item.json.message.content).situation_type : 'general') }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.original_ai_reply.replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0, 2000) }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.human_feedback.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.revised_body.replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0, 2000) }}',
  '{{ ($input.item.json.message?.content ? JSON.parse($input.item.json.message.content).lesson : 'Revisar respuesta según feedback del equipo') }}'
FROM (SELECT quickbooks_customer_id FROM public.ai_email_drafts WHERE draft_id = '{{ $('Parse Revised Draft').item.json.draft_id }}' LIMIT 1) qb

values.content: Eres un sistema de aprendizaje continuo. Extrae una lección concreta y reusable de un draft de email rechazado. Responde con JSON: { "lesson": "La lección en 1-2 oraciones", "situation_type": "tipo (scope_creep, pricing, delivery, complaint, general, etc.)" }

parameters.query:
=UPDATE public.ai_email_drafts
SET status           = 'rejected',
    rejection_reason  = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.reason.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    updated_at        = NOW()
WHERE draft_id = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.draft_id }}';

INSERT INTO public.ai_email_feedback_lessons (
  draft_id, quickbooks_customer_id, from_email, domain,
  situation_type, original_ai_reply, human_feedback, lesson
)
SELECT
  '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.draft_id }}',
  quickbooks_customer_id,
  from_email,
  split_part(from_email, '@', 2),
  '{{ ($input.item.json.message?.content ? JSON.parse($input.item.json.message.content).situation_type : 'general') }}',
  '{{ $('DB – Get Draft (REJECT)').item.json.ai_suggested_reply.replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0,2000) }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.reason.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($input.item.json.message?.content ? JSON.parse($input.item.json.message.content).lesson : 'Draft rechazado. Revisar criterios de generación') }}'
FROM public.ai_email_drafts
WHERE draft_id = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Command').item.json.draft_id }}'
